name: Texture sets (p303)
description: p303 Phase 1's texture set verification scene: the hand-made set p303TestSet (PNGs, no encode) through the { textureSet } material input in each packing, left to right LITE (its default), FULL and MINIMAL, lit by a grazing sun from the upper left. window.__textureSets holds the lookups' results, and checkReleaseAsync() leaves the scene and lists the set's textures still registered.
